criteria.description: On each request, timestamps older than 60 seconds must be removed before the count is compared against MAX_REQUESTS. After a full 60-second window elapses, a subsequent request must be allowed (HTTP 200).
criteria.evidence: rateLimiter.ts line 23: `const pruned = timestamps.filter(t => t > now - WINDOW_MS);` is applied BEFORE the `if (pruned.length >= MAX_REQUESTS)` guard at line 25. Pruning precedes the count check, satisfying the structural requirement. The bug injection confirms the original code had no filter; the current code does.

criteria.description: When a 429 is returned, the Retry-After header value must equal Math.ceil((timestamps[0] + WINDOW_MS - now) / 1000) — not the literal constant 60.
criteria.evidence: rateLimiter.ts line 26: `const retryAfter = Math.ceil((pruned[0] + WINDOW_MS - now) / 1000);` — no hardcoded `60` exists in that position. The visible test (`rateLimiter.test.ts`, test 2: 'returns 429 with a Retry-After header on the request that exceeds the limit') passed: `res.headers['retry-after']` is defined. All 21 tests passed (pnpm test output: '21 passed (21)').
